title: Bevel card
description: The site's one surface: a pale blue-grey panel with 32px corners that clips its contents, tinted from the foot with a soft colour wash (peach, green, blue, pink, teal or lavender) rising straight up or blooming low on the right.
notes: tints read the chart-1…5 and glow tokens, so other themes re-colour them
name: bevel-card

props.name: tint

props.description: the card's contents (it is a positioning context and clips them)
